answer_1.quote: We compare the proposed method against the baselines on two tasks, dialogue generation and summarization on binary feedback dataset D = {⟨x, y + , y -⟩}. We train and evaluate the methods on the Anthropic HH with 170k samples and TLDR summarization dataset with 90k samples, respectively for each task.
answer_1.outputs: Generated responses for dialogue and summaries

answer_2.quote: We measure the semantic diversity of samples by measuring the average cosine distance of SentenceBERT embeddings between a pair of samples.
automatic_metrics: semantic diversity (average cosine distance of SentenceBERT embeddings)

answer_3.quote: We conduct a pairwise comparison with GPT-4 between the generated outputs and the reference answers for a more heuristic evaluation in both tasks (Refer to Appendix A for prompts). Following , the two prompt formats were used for evaluating summarization; GPT-4 (S) simply asks which of the two better summarizes the given post, and GPT-4 (C) also asks which summary is more concise.
